protocol.primary_metric: sample-weighted CE strict correctness plus OE answer-token recall

selection.reason: Ties the best primary score with lower recorded latency; semantic-entropy arms add no primary gain. Full scale must audit the metric-invisible ventricle harm.
selection.uncertainty_safety_observation: compact_all predictive entropy rejected the observed ventricle bad rewrite while retaining all three scored improvements, but most good changes occurred when uncertainty was unavailable/abstained and the method costs 8.33x compact_rows; gate efficacy is not established.
selection.statistical_limit: Three improvements and zero metric harms on n=24 are selection evidence, not an efficacy claim or significance result.

limitations: Pilot sampled from official train split; official test remains untouched for confirmation.
Lexical token recall can hide a clinically wrong anatomical substitution.
Sequential shared-cache engine seconds are not independent cold-start latency.
Expert outputs and verifier/entropy values are not calibrated correctness probabilities.
